name: Assembly
blurb: Finland's largest gaming festival: a LAN party, esports and demoscene event held each autumn at PowerPark and each winter in Helsinki.
notes: Assembly runs multiple branded events a year under one name; both editions announced within the window (PowerPark 2026 and Winter 2027) are listed. It is a LAN-party/esports/demoscene festival with a 'CREATORS' section, but that page is an ethics/conduct guideline for streamers, not a public guest lineup with photos, so guests is 'none' for both editions (no guest program).
